youtube.title: NORMAN LEWIS
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with Dr Norman Lewis, Senior Research Fellow at the Freedom and Sovereignty Initiative Europe, about the EU’s Democracy Shield and Digital Services Act. Norman argues that expanding restrictions on online speech, election-related monitoring and pre-bunking initiatives risk undermining democratic accountability and suppressing dissent. He warns that growing efforts to control public debate could erode free speech, but believes ordinary people’s resistance offers grounds for optimism. Discover more from Norman on Substack and X
